newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan forex turnover rises in July.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan forex turnover rises in July.

text.p: Average daily turnover on Taiwan's foreign exchange market rose 1.3 percent to US$4.064 billion in July from a year earlier, the central bank said on Wednesday.

Of the daily turnover, 26.8 percent was between the U.S. dollar and the yen and 11.9 percent was between the dollar and the mark. Trade among the Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies accounted for 44.0 percent of the total.
Spot trading took 67.2 percent of the total, cross-currency swaps 17.8 percent, forward trading 7.3 percent, margin trading 6.2 percent and options 1.5 percent.
Taiwan started financial derivatives trading in early 1994.
